related_questions.question: What is the most accurate at-home COVID test?

text_blocks.snippet: The most accurate at-home COVID-19 tests are generally considered to be antigen tests. While not as sensitive as PCR tests, antigen tests are known for their speed and reliability in detecting positive cases, especially when symptoms are present.

list.title: Antigen Tests:
list.snippet: These tests are readily available over-the-counter and produce results in about 15-30 minutes. They are particularly effective at detecting active infections when symptoms are present. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov) has authorized several brands for at-home use, such as BinaxNOW, CareStart, and Flowflex.

list.title: PCR Tests:
list.snippet: While generally more sensitive and able to detect even very low levels of the virus, PCR tests typically require laboratory processing and are not available for at-home use.

list.title: Accuracy:
list.snippet: Antigen tests are highly accurate in detecting positive cases, especially when symptoms are present, says the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov). A study in Microbiology Spectrum showed that BinaxNOW tests detected nearly 90% of COVID cases when people had symptoms. However, they may have a higher rate of false negatives compared to PCR tests, meaning they might not always detect the virus in asymptomatic individuals or very early stages of infection, notes Harvard Health.
